free_tier.stated: Sandbox compute bills per second at USD 0.0333 per hour for Nano (0.5 vCPU, 0.5 GiB), USD 0.0666 for Small (1 vCPU, 1 GiB), USD 0.1332 for Medium (2 vCPU, 2 GiB), USD 0.2664 for Large (4 vCPU, 4 GiB) and USD 0.5328 for XL (8 vCPU, 8 GiB). 'Every new organization receives a one-time $5 sandbox compute credit with no payment method required.' The platform plan is USD 20 a month for Build with 3 seats, USD 100 a month for Scale with 10 seats.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The sandbox sizes line up with the whole platform: the same account supplies an AI gateway over 200 models, a vector memory store and the sandbox, so an agent can be built without a second vendor, and the sandbox is the only part billed by the second.

limits.value: Memory is 1 GiB per vCPU on every size, so a workload that needs 4 GiB of RAM has to buy a 4 vCPU box at USD 0.2664 per hour; the USD 5 credit is one per organization and does not renew.

notes: Rate per vCPU-hour works out to USD 0.0666 flat, which is a quarter above ix's USD 0.0288 and double Bunny's USD 0.02, and the RAM ratio is the reason: 1 GiB per vCPU is tight for a build that compiles anything. The USD 5 credit at USD 0.0666 per hour is 75 hours of Small. Whether sandbox compute requires the USD 20 Build plan is not stated on the pricing page; the credit is offered to a new organization with no payment method, which implies at least a trial path without one.
